name: Manuel "Manny" Acosta
office: City of South El Monte, Member of the City Council

items.text: Manuel Acosta is a South El Monte city councilmember. He was elected in 2017. He is a professor of chemistry and biomanufacturing. On the city’s projected deficit, he said in a 2026 candidate questionnaire that the city must spend less than it takes in. He supports the SGV Carshare program, saying it helps residents without vehicles get to grocery stores and medical appointments. In 2021, he proposed exploring summer concerts in city parks.
